title: Coincidence Correspondences and Nonlinear Root Geometry
summary: We show that finite morphisms of smooth algebraic varieties naturally give rise to Cartan--Coxeter type structures. Starting from the self-fiber product $X\times_YX$ of a finite morphism $Q:X\to Y$, we construct local symmetry operators and intrinsic Cartan-type invariants from the geometry of its non-diagonal irreducible components. This provides a mechanism for reconstructing root-theoretic structures directly from algebraic correspondences rather than from reflection groups.
